summary:
Exploration product (action=explore) for the accepted unit unit-claim-config-store-delivery, validated clean (valid=True).

What it does: draft/harness_configstore_test.go builds a single-voter cluster whose FSM implements FSM, BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore, commits one LogConfiguration entry via AddNonvoter, then queues a Barrier after it so the FSM goroutine has provably processed the configuration entry before sampling. It emits three CA_EVENT lines: a scenario declaration (fsm_implements_batching / fsm_implements_configuration_store), the committed configuration entry (op_id cfg-1, config_index), and the observation (entry_delivered_to_fsm via ApplyBatch, applybatch_config_indices, store_configuration_calls, store_configuration_called). This directly resolves the discriminator: whether ConfigurationStore.StoreConfiguration is invoked for a committed configuration entry when the batching path is active, or whether the entry only reaches ApplyBatch.

Construction checks done locally: gofmt parses the harness cleanly and `go vet .` over a copy of the captured module with the harness installed as assurance_generated_test.go reports no errors, so the harness compiles against the actual package (helpers inmemConfig and MakeClusterCustom are used as captured). The copy lives under draft/verify.* and is not part of the submission.

Retained uncertainty and framing: this is construction knowledge only, not a fixed check, not Evidence and not a verdict on claim-config-store-delivery. Source reading (fsm.go:118 as the sole StoreConfiguration call site, fsm.go:127-186 as the batching bypass) predicts the call is unreachable, while BatchingFSM.ApplyBatch's own doc comment (fsm.go:51-69) suggests batching FSMs may be expected to persist configuration themselves, so a negative observation here would be a source-supported discrepancy rather than yet an obligation violation. The next step is to convert this into a fixed DirectCheckPlan (prerequisite: committed configuration entry; applicability: FSM implements both interfaces; assertion: store_configuration_called eq true) with fresh execution and checker_correspondence review.
